description: This file defines the class InProcessTestClusterBuilder, which configures and builds an in-process Orleans test cluster for testing purposes. It contains constructors, configuration methods for silos and clients, and internal logic for setting up cluster options and ports.

classes.name: InProcessTestClusterBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for configuring and creating an Orleans in-process test cluster, including options for silos, clients, and port allocation.

classes.name: ConfigureStaticClusterDeploymentOptions
classes.description: An internal class implementing IHostConfigurator to configure static cluster deployment options, particularly silo names.

methods.name: InProcessTestClusterBuilder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the builder with default or specified silo count.

methods.name: InProcessTestClusterBuilder(short initialSilosCount)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the builder with specified initial silo count.

methods.name: ConfigureHost
methods.description: Adds a delegate to configure silo and client hosts.

methods.name: ConfigureSilo
methods.description: Adds a delegate to configure individual silos.

methods.name: ConfigureSiloHost
methods.description: Adds a delegate to configure silo host environments.

methods.name: ConfigureClient
methods.description: Adds a delegate to configure the Orleans client.

methods.name: ConfigureClientHost
methods.description: Adds a delegate to configure client host environments.

methods.name: Build
methods.description: Creates an InProcessTestCluster instance with the configured options.

methods.description: Generates a unique cluster identifier string with a timestamp and random suffix.
